summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting AS9100D certification, a quality management standard for aerospace and defense. This operational milestone enables the company to bid on defense tenders as a prime contractor. The filing is a routine press release furnished under Rule 13a-16, containing no transaction, no securities offering, and no corporate action affecting shareholders. It is not a special situation; the press release is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements, confirming the routine nature of the filing. No deal terms, prices, or shareholder-impacting events are stated.
